security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Check .com names in bulk, keep a watchlist, get notified.
bundle.longDescription: NameDaemon checks .com domain names in bulk against a daily snapshot of the .com zone, keeps a local watchlist and sends a notification when a watched name changes status. Free, no account, no analytics.
